label: 俯卧托腮
pose_lead: Grounded pose, prone with the chin cradled in both hands:
lower_limbs: The body lies prone, both knees bent so the lower legs kick up, the feet close together or crossed.
upper_limbs: Both elbows rest on the ground, forearms rising vertically, hands cradling the cheeks or chin.
torso_head: The chest lifts slightly off the ground with a gentle extension through the upper back; the head stays raised.
weight_silhouette: Weight spreads across the abdomen, pelvis and both elbows; the outline stays relaxed, the legs forming an upward arc.
